checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Exactly one white leather sneaker is shown.
The background is plain white, with no scenery or props.
must.why: Clean white, faint off-white vignette at edges only.

must.item: The entire shoe is visible with space around it.
must.why: Whole shoe in frame with margins, though toe/heel margins are fairly tight (~60px).

must.item: No promotional text, badges or graphic borders appear.

faults.what: Shoe is white-on-white with low contrast; the tongue/lace area is slightly ambiguous and the lace details look a bit AI-smoothed.
Faint grey-ish shadow is light, and background has slight uneven off-white tint near edges.

summary: A clean square image of a single white leather sneaker on a white background with a soft shadow, with only minor low-contrast and slight AI-smoothness issues.
